items.title: Front wheel bearing lubrication
items.summary: Front wheel bearings might not have enough grease; covered 10,504 1984 Grand Wagoneers and J-trucks.

items.title: Contaminated brake fluid
items.summary: Some 1986 Grand Wagoneers and J-trucks (230 vehicles) were filled with contaminated brake fluid, which can affect the whole braking system.

items.title: Key-operated tailgate window
items.summary: The power tailgate glass could keep closing if the spring-loaded key switch failed to return to off; part of a 180,000-vehicle campaign back to 1970 Wagoneers.

timeline.change: The SJ Wagoneer Limited becomes the Grand Wagoneer as the compact XJ takes the Wagoneer name; Brougham dropped; a no-woodgrain Wagoneer Custom lasts only this year. 258 six standard and 360 V8 optional, per Hagerty
Handling package: revised front anti-roll bar, gas shocks and lower-friction rear springs
New four-part grille and stand-up hood ornament; fully revamped interior with square gauges and improved climate control; Selec-Trac gains a Trac-Lok limited-slip; factory power sunroof option
25th anniversary: the 360 V8 becomes the only engine; 'marine teak' woodgrain, Michelin self-sealing P235/75R15s. Chrysler agrees to buy AMC in March
First full Chrysler year; carbureted 360 retained; 14,117 built

Start of the 'best of the breed' run: more reliable A/C compressor, rear wiper/washer, minivan-sourced overhead console with compass and thermometer, keyless entry, electrocoat primer and base/clear paint, gunmetal wheel inlays

Final year of the 1989–91 'best of the breed' run; buyers after the February 27 discontinuation announcement could add a gold 'Final Edition' dash badge, and Hagerty says low-mileage examples are desirable and expensive. Last truck built June 21, 1991

identify.intro: Three different Jeeps wore 'Wagoneer' in the 1980s, woodgrain is easy to stick on, and restomod shops trade on 'Final Edition' badges, so the VIN and the year-specific details matter.

items.head: SJ Grand Wagoneer vs XJ Wagoneer
items.body: The 1984–90 XJ Wagoneer and Wagoneer Limited are compact unibody Cherokees with woodgrain; the Grand Wagoneer is the body-on-frame SJ on a 108.7 in wheelbase with a 6-lug 15x7 wheel. The 1993 Grand Wagoneer is a ZJ Grand Cherokee.

items.head: VIN
items.body: Characters 6–7 read 15 on a Grand Wagoneer. On 1984–86 VINs the 4th character is the engine (C = 258 six, N = 360 V8); on 1987–90 VINs N = 5.9 V8, the only engine offered. The 10th character is the model year.

items.head: 1989–91 tells
items.body: Rear wiper/washer, overhead console with compass and outside temperature, infrared keyless entry, and alloy wheels with gunmetal-grey inlays instead of the earlier gold.

items.head: 1986-on interior
items.body: Square-gauge dash, two-spoke steering wheel, plastic woodgrain glovebox door and adjustable front head restraints mark a 1986 or later truck; earlier trucks have the old dash and metal glovebox door.

items.head: Final Edition badge
items.body: The gold 'Final Edition' dash badge was a 1991-only option for trucks sold after February 27, 1991, so one on any earlier year was added later.

capability.note: Trailer Package B (Class III), 750 lb tongue; Package A is rated 3,500 lb (1989 spec)

capability.v: 360 V8, 727 three-speed automatic, Selec-Trac NP229 with 2.6:1 low range, Dana 44 front, 2.73:1 axles

values.intro: Hagerty reported values rising through most of the 2010s, and the market is still deep: original low-mile 1989–91 trucks and Final Editions lead, while fuel-injected and LS-swapped restomods sell for whatever the build cost.
values.note: Compiled from Bring a Trailer Grand Wagoneer results in October 2026 (about 76 sales, median around $27,400, middle half roughly $17,900–42,500); the best originals and restomods reached the high $80k to low $90k range. Recheck current results before relying on these figures.
